description:
After work, the reader’s greatest joy is enjoying something delicious to eat. One day, they receive an invitation to a place called the “Secret Club.” Expecting just a restaurant, the reader is surprised when a young man suddenly appears in their room. And on top of that, the man’s lower half is… far from ordinary…?
